subject: Marketplace onboarding fee and reseller middleware revenue split negotiation
messages:
From: Harper Lin <harper@cloudbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding + middleware rev share ask

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo — CloudBridge is excited about bundling Redwood's inference as part of our Embedded AI offering. Procurement asked me to kick off pricing mechanics for the Azure marketplace listing and the reseller middleware that will route usage. High-level asks:

- One-time onboarding/listing fee to cover engineering certification + marketplace listing: we were quoted $25,000 from your partner ops.
- Revenue share on middleware (we'll operate an orchestration layer and take a share of the per-customer middleware fees): looking for 15% of middleware revenue.

Can you confirm whether a private offer (Azure) can include a pass-through on middleware fees and how you usually split commissions with resellers? We're looking to get this into a private offer in the next 2 weeks.

Attaching a short procurement note.

Attachment: cloudbridge_onboard_request.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Harper Lin
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge
harper@cloudbridge.com
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Harper Lin <harper@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-09T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding + middleware rev share ask

Hi Harper — great to hear from you and glad CloudBridge liked the demo. Quick responses and a proposed counter: 

- Onboarding/listing fee: we can reduce the one-time onboarding to $15,000 for an initial go-live window (first 6 months) in exchange for a 12-month commitment that we capture in the private offer. This covers certification and ops enablement.
- Middleware rev share: we typically do a pass-through % on third-party middleware when the partner owns the orchestration, but 15% is higher than our standard. Proposal: 10% revenue share with a tiered escalator (see Ben's note below).

Next steps: Ben and Soojin will weigh in on channel compensation and the accounting/tax implications. If you're aligned with the onboarding fee + tiered rev share we can spin a private offer draft (DocuSign) and route to legal/procurement. I've attached a quick draft term sheet for transparency.

Attachment: rw_private_offer_draft_v1.pdf (pdf)

Cheers,
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding + middleware rev share ask

Looping in some practicals from channel/finance perspective: 

- Commission waterfall (attached): suggested structure for middleware rev share: 8% on year 1 gross middleware revenue, 10% if ARR from CloudBridge packages > $500k, step to 12% once > $1.2M. This keeps initial unit economics reasonable.
- Pass-through mechanics: marketplace private offers don't always support third-party fee splits at provisioning time — we often settle middleware revenue monthly via a separate reseller invoice. That means we need a minimum guarantee or billing floor in the PO to protect Redwood for year 1.
- Tax/invoicing: recommend onboarding invoice be net of local taxes, and reseller passbacks handled as contra-revenue; ops will need a 'reseller id' to map credits.

Attachment: commission_waterfall.xlsx (xlsx)

If CloudBridge can commit to a first-year minimum guarantee (Ben suggested $20k), we can accept a blended 12% share on the waterfall with the escalator.

- Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Channel Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Harper Lin <harper@cloudbridge.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Rao <samir@acmeprocure.com>
Date: 2026-10-10T14:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding + middleware rev share ask

Thanks Rachel, Ben — appreciate the flexibility. Quick internal alignment: CloudBridge can accept the $15k onboarding fee, and we're willing to move to a 12% blended rev share with the escalator you proposed, provided two conditions are met: 

1) First-year minimum guarantee of $20k to Redwood for middleware revenue (this becomes part of the PO).
2) A clear settlement cadence (monthly statements + 30-day payment) and simple reconciliation fields so our finance team can automate passbacks.

Forwarding procurement contact (Samir) to get the PO/SOW started. Samir — attaching our internal procurement terms that reference SOW timing and a preferred 30-day net payment.

Attachment: acme_procurement_po.txt (txt)

Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding + middleware rev share ask

Harper / Samir — thanks, that reads aligned. Confirming next steps: 

- We'll generate a private offer draft that includes the $15k onboarding fee as a separate line item and the first-year $20k minimum guarantee for middleware revenue. Legal will include the monthly settlement/capability for a reseller invoice reconciliation (we'll wire standard reconciliation fields in the PO).
- I'll create the HubSpot deal and add the DocuSign private offer link; Laura will kick off the billing workflow to ensure passbacks map to your reseller id.

Can you confirm Samir's preferred billing contact and any purchase order number to appear on invoices? Once we have that, legal will route DocuSign and we can aim to sign in the next 7 business days.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/987654321/RW-2026-CB-317

Thanks again — excited to get this live.

Rachel Kim
